sentences.en: The price of rice rose by more than three percent.
sentences.zh: 大米的价格上涨了超过三个百分点。

sentences.en: Some of the tariffs were as high as sixty percent.
sentences.zh: 有些关税高达百分之六十。

sentences.en: The result placed him amongst the top one percent nationally.
sentences.zh: 这个结果使他在全国范围内位列前百分之一。

senses.zh: 百分比，百分率；部分；百分数
